title: Analysis code for: Chloride load and serum chloride in critically ill adults: a randomization-anchored analysis of the BaSICS trial
description: R code for a secondary analysis of the BaSICS randomized trial (Plasma-Lyte 148 vs 0.9% saline): cohort construction, post-randomization study-fluid chloride exposure, Bayesian hierarchical longitudinal model with eGFR effect modification, randomized normalization and inverse-probability-weighted within-saline association, Bayesian variance partition, sensitivity analyses, Table 1, and Figures 1-4. The patient-level BaSICS data are not included.
